prompt:
Subject:
Mirror selfie in a modern Japanese-style guest room

Main Subject:
A young adult woman sitting on the floor by the bedside in a spacious modern Japanese-style hotel room with tatami mats, taking a selfie through a mirror. The figure is placed prominently from the center to the lower part of the screen, with a yellow smartphone, a white sheer top, black denim shorts, and her legs spread forward as the main highlights.

Person & Expression:
A small, rounded oval face, bright and smooth skin, large dark brown eyes, thin natural eyebrows, a small nose, and pale pink lips. Facing the front mirror and camera, she glances from the side of the smartphone with a soft closed-mouth smile. Long eyelashes, thin eyeliner, and a subtle flush on her cheeks. Bright brown hair in loose, large waves reaching near her waist, with thin bangs, short strands framing her face, and hair flowing abundantly to the left shoulder on the screen.

Clothing & Pose:
A white long-sleeved cropped top with a check-like weave and sheer texture, featuring a deep V-neck lace trim, small white buttons partially fastened at the front center, and ruffled cuffs. Dark gray distressed denim shorts with thin brown cords crossing on both sides of the waist. Sitting on the tatami, stretching her left leg toward the bottom left of the screen, and bending her right knee to place her right foot in the bottom center. Holding a yellow triple-camera smartphone vertically with her right hand in front of the right half of her face, while her left hand rests on the waistband of her shorts.

Background & Lighting:
A large bed with a white duvet on the left of the screen, a warm indirect light illuminating a black shelf and small objects in the back center, an abstract black and white wall painting, a large TV and low black stand in the back right, and a bright large window on the far right. Beige tatami mats and black furniture extend throughout. Bright diffused daytime light enters from the window on the right, softly illuminating her face, white top, and legs, with warm supplementary light deeper in the room. Shadows are shallow and natural.

Composition & Camera:
Vertical 3:4 ratio. A full-body selfie composition with a wide-angle feel from the perspective of a smartphone aimed at a mirror close to the floor. The head is captured largely in the top half center, the torso in the center, and the open legs filling the bottom half, with the left leg and right foot cutting off naturally at the edges of the frame. It widely shows the guest room's bed and window to the left and right. Focused on the face, smartphone, and upper body, with a deeper depth of field where the shape of the room is recognizable.

Texture & Style:
A high-definition photorealistic live-action photo with a natural wide-angle feel as if shot with a smartphone. Realistically depicts skin, long wavy hair, sheer white woven fabric and lace, denim fraying, the yellow case, tatami mats, white bedding, and the reflection of black furniture. Based on clean white and beige tones, avoiding excessive skin smoothing filters or illustrative styles.

Negative:
Alterations to facial features, long wavy hair, sitting posture, or position of the smartphone through the mirror.
